subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-10-26 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: 卢拉连任巴西总统，武契奇承认败选；Meta 拟发股募资 350 亿美元投 AI
headline_en: Lula wins a fourth term in Brazil, Vucic concedes in Serbia, and Meta moves to raise $35 billion for AI

items.title_zh: Meta 启动 350 亿美元股票发行，为 AI 扩张筹资
items.title_en: Meta launches $35 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
items.body_zh: 路透报道，Meta 启动 350 亿美元股票发行，用于支持其人工智能扩张。这是大型科技公司为 AI 基础设施继续加码的最新一笔大规模融资。
items.body_en: Meta has launched a $35 billion stock offering to bankroll its AI expansion, Reuters reported. It is the latest mega-fundraise by a Big Tech firm to keep pace with AI infrastructure spending.

items.title_zh: Apollo 经济学家：AI 对多数企业“零财务回报”
items.title_en: Apollo economist: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies
items.body_zh: Apollo 经济学家指出，尽管投入巨大、炒作不断，AI 对美国科技行业以外的企业几乎没有带来财务回报。这一判断给当前 AI 投资热潮泼了一盆冷水。
items.body_en: An Apollo economist says AI has delivered "zero financial payoff" to corporate America outside tech, despite massive investment and hype. The verdict is a sober counterpoint to the current AI spending boom.

items.title_zh: 寒武纪陈天石否认“明年出货超百万颗”传闻
items.title_en: Cambricon CEO denies rumored million-chip shipment target for next year
items.body_zh: 针对市场传闻的百万颗芯片出货量，寒武纪董事长陈天石表示公司从未进行过相关沟通，提醒投资者以公告为准。寒武纪是本土 AI 算力芯片的主要供应商之一。
items.body_en: Cambricon chairman Chen Tianshi said the company never communicated a rumored target of shipping over a million AI chips next year, urging investors to rely on official filings. Cambricon is a major domestic supplier of AI compute chips.

items.title_zh: IBM CEO：开源权重模型已足够好、足够便宜，可本地部署
items.title_en: IBM CEO says open-weight models are now good and cheap enough for on-prem
items.body_zh: IBM CEO 表示，开源权重模型如今质量与成本都足以支撑企业本地部署。这为不愿把数据交给云端 API 的客户提供了更现实的选项。
items.body_en: IBM's CEO says open-weight models are now good and cheap enough to run on-premises. That gives enterprises wary of cloud APIs a more practical option.

items.title_zh: Anthropic CEO 呼吁加强对 AI 的监管
items.title_en: Anthropic CEO calls for stronger AI regulation
items.body_zh: ABC 新闻独家报道，Anthropic CEO 公开呼吁对人工智能实施更严格的监管。AI 公司掌门人主动要求监管，在行业里并不常见。
items.body_en: In an exclusive interview with ABC News, Anthropic's CEO called for stronger regulation of AI. It is a notable stance for the head of a leading AI lab to ask for tougher rules.

items.title_zh: 软银据报拟向马来西亚投资 500 亿美元
items.title_en: SoftBank reportedly plans $50 billion tech investment in Malaysia
items.body_zh: CNBC 报道，软银计划向马来西亚投资 500 亿美元，用于科技领域，马来西亚正把自己定位为“AI 国家”。若属实，这将是东南亚规模最大的科技投资之一。
items.body_en: SoftBank reportedly plans a $50 billion tech investment in Malaysia, which is pitching itself as an "AI nation." If confirmed, it would be one of Southeast Asia's largest tech commitments.

items.title_zh: iFixit 拆解 iPhone Duo：折叠屏与铰链设计存疑
items.title_en: iFixit teardown of iPhone Duo raises questions about folding screen and hinge
items.body_zh: iFixit 拆解苹果首款折叠机 iPhone Duo，给出 5/10 的可维修分，并指出苹果可能用某种方式隐藏屏幕折痕。此前已有用户报告铰链卡住、屏幕开裂的“crackgate”问题。
items.body_en: iFixit tore down Apple's first foldable, the iPhone Duo, giving it a 5/10 repairability score and flagging how Apple may be hiding the screen crease. The teardown follows user reports of hinges catching and screens cracking, dubbed "crackgate."

items.title_zh: 三星新广告把“苹果”切成片，宣传 Z Fold8 更薄更轻
items.title_en: Samsung ad slices an apple to tout Galaxy Z Fold8 as thinner and lighter
items.body_zh: 三星在 Instagram 投放 Galaxy Z Fold8 广告，用一颗青苹果被折叠屏切碎的画面对比苹果。广告称 Z Fold8 比“苹果”薄 1.6 毫米、轻 53 克。
items.body_en: Samsung's new Instagram ad for the Galaxy Z Fold8 shows a green apple being sliced by the folding phone. It claims the Fold8 is 1.6mm thinner and 53g lighter than "the apple" — a thinly veiled jab at Apple.

items.title_zh: Grok 发布 AI 生成《奥德赛》前七分钟
items.title_en: Grok releases first seven minutes of AI-generated 'Odyssey'
items.body_zh: Grok 公布了其 AI 生成版《奥德赛》的前七分钟片段。TechCrunch 评价画面尚可，但谈不上艺术性或人文气息。
items.body_en: Grok has released the first seven minutes of its AI-generated "Odyssey." TechCrunch's take: the footage looks okay, as long as you're not looking for artistry or human interest.

items.title_zh: 卢拉赢得巴西总统大选第四任期，博索纳罗拒绝认输
items.title_en: Lula wins fourth term as Brazil's president; Bolsonaro refuses to concede
items.body_zh: 巴西左翼领导人卢拉在第二轮投票中击败极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，第四次当选总统。多国领导人致贺，博索纳罗方面则要求废除选举结果。
items.body_en: Brazil's leftist leader Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated far-right Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff to win a fourth term. World leaders congratulated him, while Bolsonaro's camp demanded the result be annulled.

items.title_zh: 武契奇承认败选，塞尔维亚学生运动赢得议会选举
items.title_en: Vucic concedes as student-led movement wins Serbia's parliamentary election
items.body_zh: 执政 12 年的塞尔维亚总统武契奇承认其政党在议会选举中败给学生领导的“学生名单-学生获胜”运动。这场选举被视为对该国未来走向的公投。
items.body_en: Serbia's veteran leader Aleksandar Vucic, in power for 12 years, conceded that his party lost the parliamentary election to the student-led "Students Win" movement. The vote was billed as a referendum on the country's future.

items.title_zh: 苏丹快速支援部队无人机袭击五座电站，东部大范围停电
items.title_en: Sudan's RSF drone strikes hit five power stations, causing mass outages in the east
items.body_zh: 苏丹政府官员称，准军事组织快速支援部队对五座电站发动协同无人机袭击，导致东部三个州大面积停电。袭击发生在政府军控制的地区。
items.body_en: Sudan's paramilitary Rapid Support Forces launched coordinated drone strikes on five power stations, causing mass outages across three eastern states, a government official said. The stations are in army-controlled territory.

quick_zh: 紫光国微前三季度归母净利润 10.45 亿元，同比下降 17.23%。
金正恩访问中国丹东，中方称愿同朝方落实两国元首共识。
二十届五中全会在北京开始举行。
quick_en: Unigroup Guoxin's net profit fell 17.23% year on year to 1.045 billion yuan in the first three quarters.
Kim Jong Un visited Dandong in China; Beijing says it will work with Pyongyang to implement leaders' consensus.
The 20th Central Committee's fifth plenum opened in Beijing.
